purpose: Teach: 陽子/高山/高松/佐賀/島根/日本橋/水田/淵

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと陽子おばさんが学生時代の同級生だったって、聞いたわよ
lines.en: Sho, I heard that your dad and Aunt Yōko were classmates back in school.
lines.style: Gentle, curious opener. Warm tone conveying a shared discovery. Slight lift at the end — inviting him into the story, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと飛騨高山の温泉旅行行ってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to an onsen in Hida Takayama!
lines.style: Bright, urgent energy from the start. Kid's pride in the outing bubbling up. Natural child-tempo — quick, animated, eager to share the whole thing at once.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「高松のうどんは絶品」って語って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me the udon in Takamatsu is absolutely exquisite.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly amused reflection. Soft admiration for his father's passion creeping in. Measured pace, slightly dreamy — picturing the moment he spoke.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと佐賀のお祭りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to a festival in Saga with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush. Child's excitement bursting through. Quick rhythm, punchy delivery — each word tumbling over itself to get the news out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「島根の出雲大社にお参りしよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he'd like to go pay respects at Izumo Shrine in Shimane.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Gentle reverence for the intention. Slower pace, thoughtful — she's considering what it means, not just reporting it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと日本橋でお買い物したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went shopping at Nihonbashi!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Child's simple joy in the memory. Quick, direct pacing — no hesitation, just pure enthusiasm tumbling out.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「水田の風景は心が落ち着く」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that rice paddies really calm his heart.
lines.style: Soft, intimate reflection. A moment of quiet warmth — she's touching something tender he shared. Slow, almost meditative pace. Trailing gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと川の淵で魚を釣ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I fished for fish with Dad in the river!
lines.style: Bright, proud closing rush. Peak child energy — the specificity and joy of a small adventure. Eager, quick-paced, with a note of accomplishment at the end.
